newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X shares fall on rumors, gold prices.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X shares fall on rumors, gold prices.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd shares tumbled on Thursday, hurt by a renewed swirl of rumors and by a fall in the price of gold.

Shares in Bre-X, which under a recently signed deal with Freeport-McMoRan Copper & Gold Inc will hold 45 percent of the massive Busang gold deposit in Indonesia, dropped to 16.90 on the Toronto Stock Exchange before retracing slightly to trade 1.00 lower at 17.25.
Turnover was a hefty 2.56 million shares.
"There are rumors going around that they are going to lose another chunk of the property," said one portfolio manager who declined to be named.

One analyst said he had heard a rumor that Bre-X could lose another five to 10 percent of the property. But he said he knew no more details and company officials denied to him the veracity of the speculation.
Company officials were unavailable for comment when contacted by Reuters.
